outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic illustrating the experimental design, not a data plot; the check does not apply.
Bar plot of Tmprss11b mRNA (mean ± SD) shows individual data points (n=4 dots per group) overlaid on each bar.

Bar plot of Tmprss11b mRNA (mean ± SD) shows individual technical replicate points (n=4) overlaid on each bar.
This is a line plot of tumor volume over time with SEM error bars; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
